description: Run read-only DuckDB SQL over the project's GeoParquet data — filter, aggregate, join, and measure features — with optional materialisation of derived datasets.

action.description: 'preview' returns rows; 'materialize' creates a derived source.

query.description: SQL SELECT query. Use namespaced IDs as table names, e.g.: SELECT name, landuse FROM "source:516d075e-bdb5-4e27-aa61-0b14b4eff0df" WHERE landuse IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

title.description: Required for materialize: title for the new derived source.

name: geobble_project_query_database
title: Query project data
